text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper focuses on integrated modeling of climate, energy, water, and land-use systems (CLEWS) with a primary emphasis on energy system modeling and its interdependencies in Mauritius. While land-use is included as part of the integrated system, the primary objective is not land use/land cover (LULC) future prediction or simulation per se. The study does not present explicit national-scale spatial implementation of LULC prediction with quantitative accuracy metrics or mapped LULC projections as a primary focus. Instead, land-use modeling is used to inform energy system assessments. The scenarios do not focus on multiple quantitative LULC futures with spatially explicit predictions and accuracy assessments. Therefore, it fails the core inclusion criterion of a primary focus on LULC prediction and spatial modeling thereof. It also does not meet criteria for a review of LULC prediction. Hence, it is excluded.)
